description: This file implements SPDY protocol handling functions, including frame type parsing, priority and weight conversions, and frame size calculations within the SPDY/HTTP2 context.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIR
classes.description: Base class for SPDY frame representations, providing common interface methods.

classes.name: SpdyFrameWithFinIR
classes.description: Derived class for frames with a fin flag.

classes.name: SpdyFrameWithHeaderBlockIR
classes.description: Frame class containing header block data.

classes.name: SpdyDataIR
classes.description: Represents SPDY data frames with payload and flow control logic.

classes.name: SpdyRstStreamIR
classes.description: Represents RST_STREAM frames with error codes.

classes.name: SpdySettingsIR
classes.description: Represents SETTINGS frames with configuration parameters.

classes.name: SpdyGoAwayIR
classes.description: Represents GOAWAY frames with last good stream ID and error code.

classes.name: SpdyHeadersIR
classes.description: Represents HEADERS frames with header blocks.

methods.name: fin
methods.description: Returns whether the frame has the fin flag set.

methods.name: flow_control_window_consumed
methods.description: Returns the amount of flow control window consumed by the frame.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Visitor pattern method for processing different frame types.

methods.name: frame_type
methods.description: Returns the specific frame type enumeration.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the frame for serialization.

methods.name: set_error_code
methods.description: Sets the error code for RST_STREAM frames.

methods.name: set_last_good_stream_id
methods.description: Sets the last good stream ID for GOAWAY frames.
